jobs.title: Who We Serve
jobs.description: Multi-channel retailers D2C & Marketplaces Manufacturing and Auto Parts CPG and Consumer Brands 3PL and Fulfillment Providers Pre-trained agents to fix any failure. Not a fixed list of use cases. Multi-Channel Retail Find and fix your supply chain and operations failures before they cost you a repeat customer. CHALLENGE Stock that is not where the system says it is, promises that slip, orders that split, and the same failure repeating every week without anyone proving why. Find it Our forward-deployed engineers connect the systems you already run and turn scattered data into one view. Agents then cut thousands of signals down to the failures that matter. Every failure surfaced, not just the loud ones. Prove it The agent assembles evidence for one failure across systems that never agree, puts a dollar value on it, and shows its reasoning with linked sources. The cause, the cost, and the reasoning behind both. Fix it A finding isn't a fix. The agent takes corrective action, and our engineers build it into your existing tools, so the solution is autonomous instead of arriving as another report. The corrective actions, running in your own systems. At-risk order recovery Every open order is backward-scheduled from the live carrier cutoff, so failing milestones surface while recovery is still possible. Measured on at-risk orders recovered in window. Delivery-promise & OTIF Scan-to-scan transit baselines per lane show which carriers are trending to breach before the promise fails. Measured on OTIF, chargebacks and SLA credits. Split-shipment prevention Each split is reconstructed against the inventory and fulfilment logic that caused it, so the rule is fixed, not the order. Measured on split rate and cost per split. Shrink and inventory accuracy Negative adjustments and count variances are clustered by location and SKU to locate where stock is going, then a cycle count is directed at those bins. Measured on shrink dollars. Schedule a custom demo See how Beamup will find and fix your supply chain and operations failures before they cost you a repeat customer. jobs.description: AI & IT Manager Tel- Aviv, Israel Apply About Us Beamup helps enterprises move beyond dashboards, alerts, and manual triage to automated supply chain execution. Our AI platform supports large, complex retail and manufacturing networks by deploying specialized AI agents that operate continuously across stores, distribution centers, warehouses, and in-transit operations. These agents detect execution issues, identify root causes, and execute corrective actions - either autonomously or by routing work to the right teams. Retailers and manufacturers rely on Beamup to replace reactive workflows with consistent, scalable execution — reducing losses, improving performance, and operating with greater confidence at global scale. Our Mission To redefine supply chain intelligence by building AI agents that predict, prevent, and resolve inventory health and operational issues in real time. About the Role This is a dual-track role combining a forward-looking mandate to identify, implement, and maintain AI tools that improve how we work, with day-to-day IT management. You'll be the internal point of contact for all things technology, and a key partner to leadership on compliance initiatives. Responsibilities Gen-AI & Intelligent Tools This is where you'll make your biggest impact. Beamup is actively embedding AI into how we operate internally, and this person will be the engine behind that transformation. You won't just support tools, you'll shape the way the company works. Scout and evaluate the latest generative AI tools (LLMs, agents, workflow automation, AI-assisted ops) and build a clear view of what's worth adopting Own the end-to-end rollout of AI tools, from business case and procurement through integration, employee enablement, and change management Design AI-powered workflows that eliminate manual work and unlock capacity across teams (automated reporting, intelligent document handling, AI-assisted customer interactions, and more) Build internal expertise by running hands-on sessions, creating guides, and helping colleagues get real value out of the tools Monitor adoption, performance, and ROI of deployed AI tools, and iterate continuously Stay on the front edge of the gen-AI landscape, new model releases, emerging agent frameworks, to date Maintain IT documentation, asset registers, and internal knowledge bases Security & Compliance Maintain ISO certification requirements by tracking audit schedules, required documentation, management logs), tracking all controls and their status, and scheduling and supporting auditor visits Vet new suppliers before engagement by collecting security documentation, ensuring NDAs are signed, and keeping the vendor register up to date Requirements 3-5 years of experience in IT management, IT operations, or a similar role Background at a startup or scale-up environment Solid jobs.description: Senior Full-Stack Engineer Israel Apply About Us Beamup helps enterprises move beyond dashboards, alerts, and manual triage to automated supply chain execution. Our AI platform supports large, complex retail and manufacturing networks by deploying specialized AI agents that operate continuously across stores, distribution centers, warehouses, and in-transit operations. These agents detect execution issues, identify root causes, and execute corrective actions - either autonomously or by routing work to the right teams. Retailers and manufacturers rely on Beamup to replace reactive workflows with consistent, scalable execution — reducing losses, improving performance, and operating with greater confidence at global scale. Our Mission To redefine supply chain intelligence by building AI agents that predict, prevent, and resolve inventory health and operational issues in real time. Job Summary We are seeking an experienced Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join our development team. In this role, you will contribute to the entire product lifecycle, from participating in initial architectural discussions and tech-stack evaluations to the hands-on execution of complex features. We value collective intelligence, and you will be expected to bring your expertise to the table to help design scalable systems and support the team in maintaining high engineering standards. Responsibilities Architecture & Design: Actively participate in the design of new services and system components, providing input on scalability, reliability, and technical feasibility. Tech-Stack Participation: Contribute to the evaluation of new tools, libraries, and frameworks to ensure our technology stack remains efficient and effective. Feature Execution: Lead the end-to-end development of robust features, ensuring high-quality implementation across both front-end and back-end layers. Peer Mentorship: Support fellow engineers through constructive code reviews, technical guidance, and collaborative problem-solving. Continuous Improvement: Assist in identifying areas for technical improvement within our codebase and development processes, helping to implement best practices. Agentic Development: Contribute to the team's agentic toolkit by designing reusable components for agent reasoning and skill execution. Requirements 6+ years of professional experience building and scaling web applications. Strong proficiency in modern Frontend frameworks (e.g., React, Vue, or Angular) and advanced CSS/HTML. Professional experience with server-side technologies (e.g., Node.js, Python, or Go) and API design. Experience with relational and non-relational data modeling and database optimization. Demonstrated ability to contribute to architectural discussions and understand system-wide implications of technical choices. Strong understanding of cloud-native architectures, containerization (Docker/K8s), and automated CI/CD workflows. Experience with developing services and APIs in a cloud based microservices ecosystem. Advanced analytical thinking with the ability to navigate high-level ambiguity and technical complexity. Strong communication skills, capable of articulating technical decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. A natural inclination for ownership, proactive problem-solving, and driving technical initiatives to completion.
